Riyadh Conference Venues: Executive Transfer Guide for RECC, RICEC, KAICC and RFECC

Where Riyadh's major exhibitions and conferences happen — RECC in Malham, RICEC, KAICC and RFECC — and how to plan executive transfers, hourly cars and delegate movements around them.

By Taxi Saudi Arabia Editorial TeamPublished 1 October 2026Updated 2 October 20263 min read

Quick answer

Riyadh's big business events are spread across very different venues: the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Centre (RECC) in Malham, remote in the north-west with no metro; RICEC on King Abdullah Road in the centre, with a metro stop; KAICC in central Riyadh; and RFECC near King Khalid International Airport. The venue decides the transport plan — for RECC in particular, a pre-booked car with a fixed pickup time matters most.

Why the venue changes everything

"A conference in Riyadh" can mean a central venue on the metro or a site in open desert on the city's north-western edge. Before you book anything, check which venue — then plan transport around its location.

Riyadh's main event venues

VenueWhereTransport characterExamples of events held there
Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Centre (RECC)Malham, north-west RiyadhRemote, no metro — a car is essentially required; long distances from central hotelsLEAP, Black Hat MEA, Cityscape Global, Money20/20, CPHI Middle East
Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center (RICEC)Al Murabba / King Abdullah Road, centralCentral, with a direct metro stop; Radisson Blu within walking distance; ~30 min from RUHSaudi Build
King Abdulaziz International Conference Centre (KAICC)Central RiyadhGovernment and institutional eventsGlobal AI Summit (GAIN), Global Logistics Forum
Riyadh Front Exhibitions and Conferences Center (RFECC)ROSHN Front, near King Khalid International AirportClose to the airport — handy for fly-in, fly-out visitsExhibitions and fairs

Note: RECC and RICEC are different, unrelated venues — easy to confuse in an itinerary. Check the venue name on your badge or invitation.

EventVenue2026 dates

Always confirm dates on the organiser's official website before you book flights.

Planning a delegate's day

Arrival

Book the airport transfer with your flight number — we check it before pickup. Many delegates go straight from RUH to registration; if so, tell us so luggage space and timing are planned.

Hotel to venue — the morning wave

Everyone wants to arrive at opening time, so roads to the big venues are busiest then. For RECC in Malham, leave a generous margin from Olaya or KAFD hotels. For RICEC, the metro is a real alternative for a light-travelling delegate.

During the day

If you have meetings away from the venue — in KAFD or Olaya — an hourly car that waits is usually simpler than booking separate rides from a crowded venue exit.

Evening functions

Dinners and receptions are often in hotels or in Diriyah. Book the evening car in advance; at the end of a show day, everybody leaves at once.

For companies, exhibitors and organisers

  • Exhibitor stand crews need early arrivals for build-up and late departures after breakdown, often with equipment — vans or a separate luggage vehicle.
  • Speakers and VIP guests need precise timing around their session and a discreet, premium vehicle.
  • Delegations arriving on the same flight can be met by several cars or a coaster.

For more than a handful of people, ask for a written quote by email — we can quote the whole event, not ride by ride. Company invoices are available on request; corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company. See corporate event transportation.

Common questions

Is there a metro to RECC in Malham?

No. RECC is remote with no metro, so plan to go by car.

Which venue is closest to the airport?

RFECC, at ROSHN Front, is near King Khalid International Airport. RICEC is about 30 minutes from RUH.

Can one car stay with me all day?

Yes — book hourly or for the full day and the driver waits between the venue, meetings and dinner.
